title: Encrypted DNS Discovery Advertisement Planning Work Item
summary: Add deterministic router and forwarder advertisement payload planning for RFC 9463 encrypted DNS discovery.
planned_changes:
- Add advertisement status and plan models.
- Add a planner that selects DHCPv4, DHCPv6, and Neighbor Discovery payloads from local address-family inputs or ADN-only policy.
- Add an explicit platform advertisement adapter contract and fake-backed ready/blocked executor proof.
- Preserve service priority, lifetime, authentication domain name, service parameter metadata, and family-specific applicability.
- Return non-ready plans for no usable addresses or locally disabled advertisement surfaces.
- Add focused positive, negative, and edge tests plus canonical xrefs.
- Update the encrypted DNS gap ledger to separate local advertisement planning from platform emission.
verification_plan: Run the DNS project build, focused advertisement planner tests, focused encrypted DNS adapter tests, core SpecTrace validation, generated QUIC requirement coverage triage, and diff hygiene before commit.
completion_notes: The DNS package now has a trace-owned adapter-neutral advertisement payload planner for router and forwarder publication.
